facts.value: The initial input predicate enters HeavyWalk at frame zero only when shared forward-stick input passes its inclusive threshold. The initializer itself is unconditional. Active IASA checks ftCo_80094EA4, ftDk_MS_347_800E0378, then ftDk_MS_341_800DF938 with first-success short-circuiting. Only three failures reach shared tier maintenance, which synchronously calls the same initializer with a phase-adjusted frame only when the selected motion changes. Physics delegates to shared grounded walking; collision delegates to HeavyWait0.

evidence.why: Friction branch, facing-relative boundary, tier division, and missing default/validation.

facts.rationale: Documents the full delegated branch behavior and its input invariants rather than relying on the Anim name.
facts.value: Delegates to common walking animation-rate processing. A ground-friction multiplier below one selects saved walk target x0; otherwise actual ground velocity is used. Nonpositive facing-relative motion sets rate zero; positive motion uses absolute speed divided by the active slow, middle, or fast rate parameter. The shared source has no default assignment for an invalid tier and no zero/finite guard on rate denominators.
